title: Registration
steps: Register with a new email and an 8 character or longer password. Repeat the email.
expected: One account is created; duplicate email is rejected.

title: Login
steps: Log in with correct credentials, then try a wrong password.
expected: Correct login opens Dashboard; wrong login shows an error.

title: Logout and protected pages
steps: Log out, then open Dashboard directly and retry the old session.
expected: Login is required; the old session cannot access protected data.

title: User data isolation
steps: As A, check lists, charts and CSV, then request B's record ID.
expected: Only A's data appears. B's record returns 403 or 404.

title: Add expense
steps: Add INR 250, Food, today, UPI, note Lunch. Also try no note.
expected: Values save correctly; with one entry, expense is INR 2050.

title: Add income
steps: Add income INR 2000, today, source Freelance.
expected: Income is INR 12000; balance is INR 10200.

title: Amount and date validation
steps: Try 0, -1, blank or text amounts and a future date. Then try 0.01 today.
expected: Invalid input gets a field error and is not saved; valid input saves.

title: Edit transaction
steps: Change the INR 500 expense to 600; reload. Separately edit an income.
expected: Edits persist and totals update; expense edit gives INR 1900.

title: Delete confirmation
steps: Delete the INR 300 expense: first cancel, then confirm.
expected: Cancel keeps it. Confirm removes it; expense becomes INR 1500.

title: Filter and sort transactions
steps: Filter by date, category and amount. Sort both ways; try no matches.
expected: Rows and filtered total match; sorting is correct; empty total is zero.

title: Default and custom categories
steps: Check the eight SRS defaults. Add Books, use it, then rename it Study.
expected: Defaults and new category are selectable; rename persists.

title: Monthly and category budgets
steps: Set monthly budget INR 5000 and Food budget INR 1000; reload.
expected: Both budgets persist for the selected month.

title: Budget usage figures
steps: Compare monthly and Food spending with their saved budgets.
expected: Monthly: 1800 spent, 3200 left, 36%. Food: 500, 500, 50%; within INR 1.

title: Budget threshold alerts
steps: Test below 80%, at 80%, at 100% and above 100%; add another expense.
expected: Warning starts at 80%; distinct alert above 100%; entry stays allowed.

title: Monthly dashboard totals
steps: Compare monthly cards with records; switch to an empty month.
expected: Income 10000, expense 1800, balance 8200; empty month has zero totals.

title: Category and six month charts
steps: Check category totals and a six month trend with empty months.
expected: Food 500, Travel 300, Rent 1000; trend matches records; empty months are zero.

title: Filtered CSV export
steps: Filter the list and export CSV. Compare data rows with the screen.
expected: CSV downloads with correct type; rows and values match the filtered list.

title: Page load with 5000 transactions
steps: Seed 5000 transactions. Time 100 loads each of Dashboard and Transactions.
expected: At least 90 of 100 loads per page complete within 3 seconds.

title: 20 concurrent logged in users
steps: Run 20 separate logged in users together to view pages and save entries.
expected: All actions work; no server 5xx errors or mixed user data.

title: Durability and rollback
steps: Save data and restart the server. Separately force a save to fail before commit.
expected: Saved data survives; failed save leaves no partial record and allows retry.

title: Three click entry and errors
steps: Ask five first-time users to add an expense from Dashboard and correct an invalid amount.
expected: Each finishes within 3 clicks; errors explain how to correct the input.

title: Browser and mobile compatibility
steps: Check main screens and actions in Chrome, Firefox and Edge, and at 360 px width.
expected: Screens and actions work; text and controls are not clipped.

title: HTTPS and TLS
steps: Open HTTP and HTTPS URLs; check certificate, TLS version and session cookie.
expected: HTTP redirects to valid HTTPS with TLS 1.2 or later; cookie is HttpOnly and Secure.

title: Salted password hashes
steps: Create two accounts with the same password. Check stored hashes and logs.
expected: Salted bcrypt or PBKDF2 hashes differ; no plain or reversible passwords are stored or logged.

title: Owner authorisation
steps: As A, try reading, editing and deleting B's transactions, budgets and categories.
expected: 403 or 404 is returned; B's data is unchanged.

title: SQL injection and stored XSS
steps: Try SQL injection in login and text fields; save a script tag in a note. Check query handling.
expected: No login bypass or query manipulation; script renders as text. Queries use parameters or an ORM.

title: Password length and login lockout
steps: Try 7 and 8 character passwords. Fail login five times; try again immediately and after 5 minutes.
expected: 7 is rejected, 8 accepted. After five failures, login is blocked for 5 minutes, then correct login works.
